[spoiler=[b]Mainland operations resume[/b]]
Commanders on the frontlines would be given new orders. Despite negotiations going downhill, the ceasefire was still holding, but not for long. Hydronian strategists had worked along side their Karcovian counterparts to create a new strategy to push back the Kaiserreich. A total of 140,000 Hydronian troops would be concentrated in two positions. First, 100,000 along the southern parts of the frontlines, parallel to Lumirs southern border. The other position would be in Seraphar, the state capital of Lumir, where 40,000 troops would serve as backup in the case that the frontline positions failed.

The Hydronians in the south would begin a feint attack, almost as soon as negotiations ended. The goal of this would be to draw masses of reichswehr resources towards a false target, so that the Karcovians could begin the real attack. Surface-to-surface IR homing missiles and artillery fire would be used to take out Kaiserreich anti-air and radar first. Once this was done, the aircraft would be redeployed. Armed with IR interceptors, air-to-surface missiles and simple gravity bombs (just regular old dumb bombs) they would begin more deadly strikes upon the Kaiserreich. First, IR homing air-to-surface missiles would allow for precision strikes to oil tankers, supply lines, radar, anti-air and other infrastructure necessary for the Kaiserreich to sustain themselves in Hydronian territory. Once this had been done, the jets would initiate a carpet bombing attack across reichswehr-held territory, making use of cheap, simple gravity bombs. Any incoming missiles would be dealt with using the IR interceptors. On the ground. Surface-to-air missiles would target any Kaiserreich aircraft in the sky.

Whilst this unfolded in the sky, tanks would roll forward and attack Kaiserreichs positions on the ground, being careful to stay out of the way of the carpet bombing, occurring further back into Kaiserreich territory. Making use of high-explosive antitank shells, they would aim to disable Kaiserreich armoured vehicles and tanks. Additionally, machine gunners would continually fire on any enemy solider unlucky enough to come into their line of sight.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]In the sea[/b]]
2 of the 3 submarines would be hit and sunk by the Kaiserreich torpedoes and UUVs, but whilst the other two sank, it provided cover for the third to escape. It would manage to retreat back into the eastern strait and begin moving back to a southern port.

Deeper underwater, the stealth submarine, armed to the teeth with high-yield torpedoes, would begin reconnaissance operations. It would slowly weave in and out of the Kaiserreich fleet, collecting data on them, which would be transmitted back to the approaching Karcovian ships. The submarine would then wait for the signal to strike from the Karcovians. The aim would be to overwhelm the Kaiserreich fleet by attacking from below, whilst they are engaged with the Karcovians.
[/spoiler]
